spans.text: DURNYAŊ KIKƐ BE KEYILI KPRA TA LAŊƐ DIMEDI KIKƐ BE KUMU SO BE ASHYEŊ NƐ MOBE KASHINTEŊ AKPA
Durnyaŋ kikɛ be nshɛr gboŋ nna yili dimedi kikɛ be kumu so be asheŋ nɛ kashinteŋ ere.

entries.task_id: dimedi|be|eyilikpa nɛ mobe kumu so be asheŋ e la mobe kashinteŋ nɛ eyur-wushi be egbel-tulwase
entries.description: dimedi be eyilikpa nɛ mobe kumu so be asheŋ e la mobe kashinteŋ nɛ eyur-wushi be egbel-tulwase
entries.subject: dimedi
entries.object: eyilikpa nɛ mobe kumu so be asheŋ e la mobe kashinteŋ nɛ eyur-wushi be egbel-tulwase

spans.text: Kepin nɛ kemaŋkura, dimedi be eyilikpa nɛ mobe kumu so be asheŋ e la mobe kashinteŋ nɛ eyur-wushi be egbel-tulwase.

Kedɔ nɛ kekplaŋ dimedi be kashinteŋ ere so e naa bra barkɔnɛ, a duu mfɛra lubi dimedi be kumu to, n naŋ shi nɛ durnyaŋ to dimedi bu kebaa malga yɛlyɛla, ebɔrɛshuŋ, kayeŋi-yeŋi nɛ kanyɛ kii asheŋ kpakpa so bebolpo kutɔ.

spans.text: Ku daga fanɛ awura-sheŋ be mbra ka bee kuŋ dimedi be kashinteŋ n sa maa shi nɛ eko maa kini mo barkasa nko a nyaŋ mo.

entries.task_id: kumu|be|kekeni nko lakal ko
entries.description: kumu be kekeni nko lakal ko
entries.subject: kumu
entries.object: kekeni nko lakal ko

spans.text: Ekama kɔ ekpa ta a laŋɛ kashinteŋ ere kikɛ nɛ kumu so be asheŋ nɛ a wɔ keyili kpra ere to nɛ nkpiɛto kikɛ maŋ wɔtɔ ashi yiri, kawol be ndu li, kenyɛn/keche, ngbar, ebɔrɛ shuŋ, kumu be kekeni nko lakal ko, efuli so nko kebawɔtɔ be ekpa so, kapitɛ, kakurwe nko eyililkpa ko be kabaso.

N naŋ tii so, nkpiɛto kikɛ e sa maŋ wɔtɔ ta a yɔ kumu be kekeni to, demu-ji to, nko efuli nɛ fo shi be eyilikpa durnyaŋ to nɛ loŋ be efuli nna suwe kumo kumu a keni kumo kumu so, nko efuli ko e naa keni kumu so ekpa ko so.
Ekama kɔ kashinteŋ nɛ e baa kɔ mobe kumu so be kapitɛ nko mo nɛ mo bra-ana.
La be kashinteŋ tii mobe kechɛrga kananɛ e bee bunyaŋ ebɔrɛ nko mobe yɛrda, nɛ mobe kumu so be keshuŋ ebɔrɛ-shuŋ mo nawule nko mo nɛ mo bra-ana.

spans.text: Ekama kɔ kashinteŋ, kaplɛ-kama nɛ e wɔ nɛ bu pin fanɛ esa e la mo mbra be ekpa so.
Ekama na la kukoŋwule nna mbra be ekpa so, a daga nɛ mbra na e kuŋ ekama nɛ nkpiɛto maŋ wɔtɔ.
Ekama nɛ bu fa fo, fo kɔ kashinteŋ nɛ fo keni kefa nna, amɔ bu ji na mbri fo mbra be ekpa so jimaa to nɛ fo maŋ tiŋ chɛ fo kɔnɔ.

entries.task_id: efuli na|be|demu-ji akpa nɛ e ya dɔ kashinteŋ kpra nɛ mbra yili mo nna so
entries.description: efuli na be demu-ji akpa nɛ e ya dɔ kashinteŋ kpra nɛ mbra yili mo nna so
entries.subject: efuli na

spans.text: Ekama kɔ kashinteŋ nɛ bu yolge mo ashi efuli na be demu-ji akpa nɛ e ya dɔ kashinteŋ kpra nɛ mbra yili mo nna so.
Nɛ bu fa esa kumobe ekpa so nkpal ashuŋ lubi nɛ e maa liɛ efuli na be kumu be kekeni be ekpaso nko asheŋ nɛ a bee dɔɔ kɔnɔkoŋwule be mbra na so, le be kashinteŋ maŋ wɔtɔ.
Ekama kɔ kashinteŋ nɛ e baa wɔ efuli so be awura-sheŋ to mo gbagba nko nɛ bu lara ba sa yɛlyɛla so nɛ bu yili bumo be ntilemu.
Ekama kɔ kashinteŋ nɛ eji mobe efuli so be kusɔnɛ ku la ekama peyɛ be tunɔ kananɛ eko gba beeŋ ji kumobe tunɔ nna.

Baasa be aparsheŋ a daga a ka la awura-sheŋ be egbel tulwase la be aparsheŋ daga nɛ a shi saŋɛ saŋɛ be kɔnkɔŋ be kelɛ kashinteŋ be ekpa so n naa la ekama be kesheŋ nɛ baa lɛ kɔnkɔŋ nna kegblanto nko kumo nɛ ku bɛ kɔnkɔŋ be kelɛ be mbra so.

entries.subject: mobe kushuŋ
entries.object: tunɔ

spans.text: Ekama kɔ kashinteŋ nɛ e ji mobe kushuŋ be tunɔ, mo nawule nko mo nɛ mobe keyale nɛ e naa wɔ kebawɔtɔ nɛ ku daga dimedi, n naŋ fin kechɛto ko nɛ ku daga ashi baasa kutɔ.

entries.subject: wɔ beshumpo
entries.object: kɔnɔkoŋwule to nɛ bu baa kuŋ mobe aparsheŋ

spans.text: Ekama kɔ kashinteŋ nɛ e baa wɔ beshumpo be kɔnɔkoŋwule to nɛ bu baa kuŋ mobe aparsheŋ.

entries.description: alaŋɛ eyur be alemfia
entries.subject: alaŋɛ eyur
entries.object: alemfia

spans.text: Ekama kɔ kashinteŋ nɛ e ba wɔ kebawɔtɔ lɛla to, mo nɛ mobe keyale, ta alaŋɛ eyur be alemfia, ajibi-ji so, asɔ-buuso, kowu chena so to nɛ kusɔ kama nɛ ku la jamaa peyɛ, e naa kɔ kashinteŋ nɛ e kuŋ mobe kumu saŋɛ nɛ e maŋ naa wɔ kushuŋ to, nɛ e ka wɔ kulɔ to, nɛ kekulwu to, nɛ kenimu to nko kebawɔtɔ ko nɛ ku maŋ duli mo.

spans.text: Ekama kɔ kashinteŋ nɛ e ba wɔ kebawɔtɔ lɛla to, mo nɛ mobe keyale, ta alaŋɛ eyur be alemfia, ajibi-ji so, asɔ-buuso, kowu chena so to nɛ kusɔ kama nɛ ku la jamaa peyɛ, e naa kɔ kashinteŋ nɛ e kuŋ mobe kumu saŋɛ nɛ e maŋ naa wɔ kushuŋ to, nɛ e ka wɔ kulɔ to, nɛ kekulwu to, nɛ kenimu to nko kebawɔtɔ ko nɛ ku maŋ duli mo.

folded.subject: ana kikɛ
folded.object: mbra so

spans.text: A maŋ daga nɛ bu fa ekama nkpal kesheŋ nɛ ku maŋ daga kusoe gberge so ashi efuli na nko efuli-ana kikɛ be mbra so, saŋɛ nɛ e wɔrɔ la be kesheŋ na.

folded.id: ana|be|kakurwe kelepo so
folded.subject: ana
folded.object: kakurwe kelepo so

spans.text: A daga keteŋi efuli-ana be kakurwe kelepo so.

folded.id: ana|be|keblase to nɛ amobe kapitɛ be albarka to nɛ fo nya eyilikpa nɛ naŋkur nɛ ku daga fo dimedi nɛ dankare be ekpa so
folded.subject: ana
folded.object: keblase to nɛ amobe kapitɛ be albarka to nɛ fo nya eyilikpa nɛ naŋkur nɛ ku daga fo dimedi nɛ dankare be ekpa so

spans.text: Fo kama nɛ fo wɔ baasa to, fo kɔ kashinteŋ nɛ baasa e kuŋ fo, a daga nɛ fobe efuli so nɛ efuli-ana kikɛ ka pɛ abar be kashɛr to, efuli-ana be keblase to nɛ amobe kapitɛ be albarka to nɛ fo nya eyilikpa nɛ naŋkur nɛ ku daga fo dimedi nɛ dankare be ekpa so.

folded.id: ana|be|kenyi kikɛ e baa wɔ kakil na to
folded.subject: ana
folded.object: kenyi kikɛ e baa wɔ kakil na to

spans.text: Pɔɛ nɛ baasa e kil abar, a daga nɛ bumo-wura-ana be kenyi kikɛ e baa wɔ kakil na to.

folded.id: ashi baasa|be|kebaa luri mobe asheŋ to nɛ ketige nko nduwɛ mobe jilma so
folded.subject: ashi baasa
folded.object: kebaa luri mobe asheŋ to nɛ ketige nko nduwɛ mobe jilma so

spans.text: Ekama kɔ kashinteŋ nɛ mbra na e kuŋ mo ashi baasa be kebaa luri mobe asheŋ to nɛ ketige nko nduwɛ mobe jilma so.

Baasa be aparsheŋ a daga a ka la awura-sheŋ be egbel tulwase la be aparsheŋ daga nɛ a shi saŋɛ saŋɛ be kɔnkɔŋ be kelɛ kashinteŋ be ekpa so n naa la ekama be kesheŋ nɛ baa lɛ kɔnkɔŋ nna kegblanto nko kumo nɛ ku bɛ kɔnkɔŋ be kelɛ be mbra so.

folded.id: dimedi|be|eyilikpa nɛ mobe kumu so be asheŋ e la mobe kashinteŋ nɛ eyur-wushi be egbel-tulwase
folded.subject: dimedi
folded.object: eyilikpa nɛ mobe kumu so be asheŋ e la mobe kashinteŋ nɛ eyur-wushi be egbel-tulwase

spans.text: Kepin nɛ kemaŋkura, dimedi be eyilikpa nɛ mobe kumu so be asheŋ e la mobe kashinteŋ nɛ eyur-wushi be egbel-tulwase.

Kedɔ nɛ kekplaŋ dimedi be kashinteŋ ere so e naa bra barkɔnɛ, a duu mfɛra lubi dimedi be kumu to, n naŋ shi nɛ durnyaŋ to dimedi bu kebaa malga yɛlyɛla, ebɔrɛshuŋ, kayeŋi-yeŋi nɛ kanyɛ kii asheŋ kpakpa so bebolpo kutɔ.

folded.id: durinya kikɛ|be|mmalga yiliso so
folded.subject: durinya kikɛ
folded.object: mmalga yiliso so

spans.text: Ekama nta n-ya mata durinya kikɛ be mmalga yiliso so.

folded.id: durnyaŋ kikɛ|be|keyili kpra ta laŋɛ dimedi kikɛ be kumu so be ashyeŋ nɛ mobe kashinteŋ akpa
folded.subject: DURNYAŊ KIKƐ
folded.object: KEYILI KPRA TA LAŊƐ DIMEDI KIKƐ BE KUMU SO BE ASHYEŊ NƐ MOBE KASHINTEŊ AKPA

spans.text: DURNYAŊ KIKƐ BE KEYILI KPRA TA LAŊƐ DIMEDI KIKƐ BE KUMU SO BE ASHYEŊ NƐ MOBE KASHINTEŊ AKPA
Durnyaŋ kikɛ be nshɛr gboŋ nna yili dimedi kikɛ be kumu so be asheŋ nɛ kashinteŋ ere.

folded.id: ebɔrɛ so|be|kesheŋ na n naa la baasa to be katuŋ junkpar po nɛ a daga nɛ jamaa nɛ efuli kikɛ e baa kuŋ kumo
folded.subject: ebɔrɛ so
folded.object: kesheŋ na n naa la baasa to be katuŋ junkpar po nɛ a daga nɛ jamaa nɛ efuli kikɛ e baa kuŋ kumo

spans.text: Kanaŋ la ebɔrɛ so be kesheŋ na n naa la baasa to be katuŋ junkpar po nɛ a daga nɛ jamaa nɛ efuli kikɛ e baa kuŋ kumo.

folded.id: efuli na|be|demu-ji akpa nɛ e ya dɔ kashinteŋ kpra nɛ mbra yili mo nna so
folded.subject: efuli na
folded.object: demu-ji akpa nɛ e ya dɔ kashinteŋ kpra nɛ mbra yili mo nna so

spans.text: Ekama kɔ kashinteŋ nɛ bu yolge mo ashi efuli na be demu-ji akpa nɛ e ya dɔ kashinteŋ kpra nɛ mbra yili mo nna so.
Nɛ bu fa esa kumobe ekpa so nkpal ashuŋ lubi nɛ e maa liɛ efuli na be kumu be kekeni be ekpaso nko asheŋ nɛ a bee dɔɔ kɔnɔkoŋwule be mbra na so, le be kashinteŋ maŋ wɔtɔ.
Ekama kɔ kashinteŋ nɛ e baa wɔ efuli so be awura-sheŋ to mo gbagba nko nɛ bu lara ba sa yɛlyɛla so nɛ bu yili bumo be ntilemu.
Ekama kɔ kashinteŋ nɛ eji mobe efuli so be kusɔnɛ ku la ekama peyɛ be tunɔ kananɛ eko gba beeŋ ji kumobe tunɔ nna.

folded.id: efuli so|be|keshi jiga-jiga nko n kini mobe kechɛrga efuli nɛ e shi na so
folded.subject: efuli so
folded.object: keshi jiga-jiga nko n kini mobe kechɛrga efuli nɛ e shi na so

spans.text: A maŋ daga kekini eko mobe efuli so be keshi jiga-jiga nko n kini mobe kechɛrga efuli nɛ e shi na so.

folded.object: kepin kashinteŋ nɛ kumu so be asheŋ ere e la demu kpra nɛ ku beeŋ chɛ to n teŋi ntaŋ ere so

spans.text: Ekama be kepin kashinteŋ nɛ kumu so be asheŋ ere e la demu kpra nɛ ku beeŋ chɛ to n teŋi ntaŋ ere so.

folded.subject: eyililkpa ko
folded.object: kabaso

spans.text: Ekama kɔ ekpa ta a laŋɛ kashinteŋ ere kikɛ nɛ kumu so be asheŋ nɛ a wɔ keyili kpra ere to nɛ nkpiɛto kikɛ maŋ wɔtɔ ashi yiri, kawol be ndu li, kenyɛn/keche, ngbar, ebɔrɛ shuŋ, kumu be kekeni nko lakal ko, efuli so nko kebawɔtɔ be ekpa so, kapitɛ, kakurwe nko eyililkpa ko be kabaso.

spans.text: Kenyaya, kenya-tɔ nɛ kenya-fa be ekpa kama so daga ku ju.

folded.object: asheŋ to jigajigaso

spans.text: A maŋ daga nɛ fo luri fo barkasa be asheŋ to jigajigaso, mo dawule, mobe keyale nko mobe kebɔaya akpa, nko nɛ fo tige fo barkasa be jilma nɛ mobe eyilikpa so.

folded.object: mfɛra be kashinteŋ

spans.text: Ekama kɔ mobe kumu so be mfɛra be kashinteŋ, lakal nɛ kananɛ e bee bunyaŋ ebɔrɛ.

folded.object: kekeni nko lakal ko

spans.text: Ekama kɔ ekpa ta a laŋɛ kashinteŋ ere kikɛ nɛ kumu so be asheŋ nɛ a wɔ keyili kpra ere to nɛ nkpiɛto kikɛ maŋ wɔtɔ ashi yiri, kawol be ndu li, kenyɛn/keche, ngbar, ebɔrɛ shuŋ, kumu be kekeni nko lakal ko, efuli so nko kebawɔtɔ be ekpa so, kapitɛ, kakurwe nko eyililkpa ko be kabaso.

N naŋ tii so, nkpiɛto kikɛ e sa maŋ wɔtɔ ta a yɔ kumu be kekeni to, demu-ji to, nko efuli nɛ fo shi be eyilikpa durnyaŋ to nɛ loŋ be efuli nna suwe kumo kumu a keni kumo kumu so, nko efuli ko e naa keni kumu so ekpa ko so.

Ekama nɛ bu fa fo, fo kɔ kashinteŋ nɛ fo keni kefa nna, amɔ bu ji na mbri fo mbra be ekpa so jimaa to nɛ fo maŋ tiŋ chɛ fo kɔnɔ.

spans.text: A maŋ daga nɛ bu fa ekama nkpal kesheŋ nɛ ku maŋ daga kusoe gberge so ashi efuli na nko efuli-ana kikɛ be mbra so, saŋɛ nɛ e wɔrɔ la be kesheŋ na.
A maŋ naŋ daga nɛ bu gberge esa kusoe nɛ ku baa chɔ kumo nɛ bu junkpar n sa mo saŋɛ nɛ e wɔrɔ loŋ be kesheŋ nna.
